classic_pairs.name: same direction, different magnitude
classic_pairs.story: (1,1) and (10,10) point the same way — cosine sees them as identical (1.0); Euclidean treats them as far apart (~12.7).

classic_pairs.name: orthogonal
classic_pairs.story: (1,0) and (0,1) are at 90° — cosine = 0 (no shared direction).

classic_pairs.name: opposite
classic_pairs.story: (1,1) and (-1,-1) point the opposite way — cosine = -1.

tfidf_pair.observation: Same-topic pair has HIGHER cosine; cross-topic pair has LOWER cosine. Euclidean is also smaller for same-topic, but the gap is narrower and length-sensitive.
